subject: Confidential: Attrition case — pay hold & access freeze (Neha K.)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Resignation — last day April 1

Rishi,

I wanted to let you know I have decided to resign from Redwood. My last day will be April 1. This was a difficult decision; I appreciate the opportunities and the team. I will do a full handoff of my active work and help with the transition.

I attached a signed resignation letter per HR standard. Please advise next steps for offboarding, final pay, and any paperwork I should expect.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Data Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: neha_resignation_signed.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Confidential: Attrition case — pay hold & access freeze (Neha K.)

Team — forwarding Neha's resignation. Marking this confidential for now; she asked for a standard transition but there are a couple of flags I want to check before we open broad comms:

- Neha had access to model evaluation buckets and a private S3 namespace used for research experiments.
- She was working on the payment routing POC (contains customer PII in test data).

Requested actions:
1) People Ops (Stephanie/Evelyn): prepare final pay run and confirm any standard severance entitlements. She has requested April 1 as last day; can we run off-cycle if needed?
2) Legal (Monica): please confirm IP/NDAs and any separation language to include in a severance offer.
3) IT/Security (Lauren): please put an access freeze on Neha's accounts (no deletion) and produce an account access list we can review.

I've attached her signed resignation. Will coordinate the handoff plan after we sync. Please reply-all with confirmation and ETA.

-Rishi
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: neha_resignation_signed.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-04T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Confidential: Attrition case — pay hold & access freeze (Neha K.)

Thanks Rishi — received.

Quick plan and asks: 
- We will prepare a standard separation packet. Given Neha's seniority and access, recommend offering the standard 8 weeks severance contingent on execution of the separation agreement (template attached).
- Please do not notify the team until we finalize the package and legal has reviewed.
- People Ops can process last pay on the normal payroll cycle but can issue an interim payment if needed; confirm with me by EOD if you want off-cycle.
- Security: please implement an access freeze effective immediately (disable login and initiate credential rotation for services she touched). Do NOT delete any S3 objects or Git branches until legal confirms.

Monica — I attached a draft severance offer for review (severance_offer_draft.docx). If you can send redlines by EOD tomorrow I will share with Rishi and the employee via DocuSign.

Stephanie — I need a headcount / payroll impact estimate for Finance (cc'd) and confirmation on whether PTO pay follows state rules (Neha is CA).

Thanks,
Evelyn
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: severance_offer_draft.docx

From: Lauren Bennett <lauren_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-05T15:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Confidential: Attrition case — pay hold & access freeze (Neha K.)

Confirmed: access freeze scheduled for 2027-03-05 17:00 PT. Actions taken:
- Disabled primary SSO and MFA for neha_kapoor@redwood.ai (login blocked, recovery contact retained).
- Rotation of service credentials for S3 buckets: model-eval-prod and research-experiments (keys rotated; existing objects not deleted).
- Created access export (access_freeze_list.csv) with IAM roles, active keys, and services touched — attached for review.
- Snapshot of her EC2 workspace and attached disk created and stored under SecureHR/archive/neha_kapoor_snapshot.tar.gz (retention per legal hold).

If Legal flags any additional holds, we will escalate and preserve logs.

-Lauren
Head of IT Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: access_freeze_list.csv
